validity.researcher_notes: Two separate spec-scope defects found on this row, both tracing to the same class of error (a system/programme-wide figure misattributed to a single segment): (1) SEGMENTCOST -- recorded value 49,980,000.00 (units column blank on the sheet, presumably RUB) numerically matches -- same leading digits '4998' -- the PROGRAMME-WIDE Gazprom financing commitment for the ENTIRE 2021-2025 Karelia gas-supply/gasification programme: 49.98 BILLION rubles (49,980,000,000), per dp.ru 2022-02-22 ('Финансирование этой программы со стороны Газпрома составит 49,98 млрд рублей'). Flagging as a probable-cause finding, not a certainty -- recommend removing/replacing the segment cost value rather than treating the row as fully unresolved on this point. (2) CAPACITY -- the only sourced basis for Capacity=40.00 bcm/y (federal decree 816-r item #388, corroborated by amendment 3302-r) is a SINGLE line item covering the WHOLE Volkhov-Segezha-Kostomuksha corridor end to end (Volkhovsky district, Leningrad oblast, through Kostomukshsky district, Karelia), not a per-stage breakdown.
